baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of word 3 (ahata) with word 6 (khubran).
baseline_models.mechanism: All-sided enclosure combines with knowledge of an affair's interior, so the clause asserts exhaustive depth rather than receipt of a report.

activation_trace.role: Complete enclosure in knowledge supplies the mechanism's all-sided epistemic scope.
Knowledge of news and an affair's interior supplies depth beyond outward report.

changed_reading.before: God knew what was with him.
changed_reading.after: God's prior knowledge completely surrounds every side and inward reality of what was present to him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 3's preserving branch acts on the open referent 'what was with him,' while word 6 supplies informed inward awareness.
baseline_models.mechanism: Enclosure can be protective custody as well as perimeter; joined to khubr, it yields watchful care that knows what it preserves.

activation_trace.role: Preservation, care, and precaution turn encompassing into active custody.
Interior knowledge makes the proposed custody informed rather than merely defensive.

changed_reading.before: The clause reports detached awareness of his circumstances.
changed_reading.after: The clause can also place him and what attended him under informed, preserving oversight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The physical branches available at focus words 3 and 6 permit a terrain-level model without leaving the clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sensory enclosure combines with kh-b-r's low, soft, watered ground to picture knowledge as an all-around survey of the material station.

activation_trace.role: Physical surrounding or fencing supplies a surveyed perimeter.
Soft or low ground with water supplies the exploratory terrain content inside that perimeter.

changed_reading.before: Khubr is treated as purely propositional knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the knowledge is embodied as a complete survey of the ground and conditions at his station.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recital, preserved recollection, linked means, trace-following, and arrivals at limits turn the focus clause into an epistemic checkpoint within an ordered itinerary.

activation_trace.role: Complete epistemic enclosure gives the ordered account a scope larger than any one disclosed station.
Knowledge of the inner affair makes the sequence an informed account, not a bare travel list.
Following and succession make the promised recital an ordered trace.
Preserved recollection supplies continuity across the narrated stations.
The rope or connecting-link image joins otherwise separate stages into one itinerary.
Tracing mark after mark makes movement evidence-bearing and sequential.
The repeated trace-following renews the same ordered mechanism after the first station.
Trace-following immediately after the focus marks its clause as a checkpoint rather than an ending.
Arrival at a limit supplies the next bounded station in the traced sequence.

structural_cues: The route formula recurs at 18:85, 18:89, and immediately after the focus at 18:92.
The focus begins with a sealing 'thus' but the linked itinerary continues.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered recital, links, repeated following, and bounded arrivals; I infer that the focus clause calibrates the account's epistemic completeness at a midpoint. A live alternative is that it merely closes the eastern episode.

changed_reading.before: The clause is a free-standing assertion of omniscience.
changed_reading.after: The clause is also a checkpoint saying that the already-complete account surrounds each locally disclosed stage while the traveler proceeds link by link.

context_deltas.mechanism: The total grant of power and connected means is followed by intended action and recompense; this broadens 'what was with him' from inventory to endowed capacities and their use.

activation_trace.role: Complete enclosure gathers capacities, choices, and consequences into one known field.
Knowledge of the inward affair reaches intention and use, not only visible possession.
Empowerment supplies operative capacity among the things present to him.
Giving marks those capacities as an endowment rather than self-originating property.
Totality and enclosure expand the endowment across the available field.
The knowable, reportable thing makes the broad grant available for epistemic accounting.
A connecting rope or means turns possession into usable access.
Intended action supplies the morally legible use of endowed capacity.
Recompense links the use of capacity to an answering consequence.

structural_cues: 18:84 grants power and every means before the ruler chooses between punishment and good at 18:86-88.
The focus's open phrase 'what was with him' follows another deployment of a route or means.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies granted power, total means, intended work, and recompense; I infer an accountability relation between endowment and use. The live narrower alternative is that the focus referent denotes only his immediate circumstances or retinue.

changed_reading.before: 'What was with him' means belongings, retinue, or current circumstances.
changed_reading.after: It can include the full endowment of power, accessible means, intended uses, and consequences present to his agency.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated finding gives the traveler episodic contact with surfaces, while later near-failure to understand speech exposes a limit that the focus's all-sided interior khubr exceeds.

activation_trace.role: Complete enclosure supplies an epistemic field not limited to successive encounters.
Knowledge of an affair's interior supplies the depth missing from mere finding.
Finding at the western station supplies discrete encounter with a scene and a people.
A second finding repeats the traveler's station-bound mode of access.
The third finding continues episodic contact immediately before a comprehension limit appears.
Understanding marks an inward-semantic threshold that the encountered people scarcely cross.

structural_cues: Three station clauses repeat 'reached ... found'; the focus follows the second.
The third station couples finding people with their near-failure to understand speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring finding, later failed comprehension, and a focus branch for inward knowledge; I infer an epistemic hierarchy from encounter to interior understanding. A live alternative is a neutral omniscient narrator marker with no implied limit on the traveler.

changed_reading.before: The ruler's discoveries and God's knowledge lie on the same descriptive plane.
changed_reading.after: The traveler's repeated findings are local surface encounters already nested beneath God's complete knowledge of both him and the inward reality of what he meets.

context_deltas.mechanism: The eastern people lack material covering, yet the next people are difficult to understand; physical exposure is therefore a foil, not a cause, for the focus's interior knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Physical surrounding supplies the spatial model whose limits the context tests.
Knowledge of the inner affair distinguishes genuine transparency from mere visibility.
The explicit absence of covering makes the eastern group materially exposed.
The later difficulty of understanding supplies semantic opacity despite bodily encounter.

structural_cues: The focus stands between a people described by lack of cover and a people described by difficulty of comprehension.
The first description concerns exposure; the second concerns intelligibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical uncovering and later semantic opacity; I infer a deliberate contrast across the hinge. They may instead be independent descriptions, and divine knowledge need not depend on either visibility or speech.

changed_reading.before: An all-around survey could imply that visible, uncovered conditions make the station knowable.
changed_reading.after: Exposure does not yield interior transparency: what remains opaque to human encounter is nevertheless completely encompassed as khubr.

context_deltas.mechanism: After God epistemically encompasses the ruler, the ruler builds a bounded enclosure that blocks crossing and piercing but is later leveled; the encloser and his finite enclosure remain nested inside prior divine knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Physical surrounding supplies the lexical bridge from epistemic encompassing to the later barrier.
Complete encompassing in knowledge establishes the larger enclosure that contains the builder and wall.
Interior knowledge makes the larger enclosure epistemic rather than another material wall.
The two existing barriers introduce blockage of a gap as the next episode's material problem.
The requested barrier makes physical gap-closing an intentional protective project.
Filling a breach supplies the constructed enclosure's operative form.
A distinguishing boundary gives the enclosure a hard material limit.
Failure to pierce through demonstrates the wall's temporary closure.
Demolition to level ground exposes the finite enclosure's destined endpoint.

structural_cues: The focus immediately precedes the route that culminates in construction of the barrier.
The wall defeats both going over and piercing through at 18:97, then is promised leveling at 18:98.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus enclosure branch, a barrier sequence, blocked penetration, and eventual leveling; I infer a nested-enclosure analogy. A live alternative is simple narrative juxtaposition, with the later wall illustrating sovereignty rather than activating the focus lexeme.

changed_reading.before: God completely knows the ruler's present circumstances.
changed_reading.after: The One whose knowledge encloses the ruler also encloses the ruler's enclosure, its successful limits, and its appointed ending.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preserving branch of encompassing is activated as informed protection: threatened people, diagnosed corruption, cooperative force, gathered blocks, and equalization convert oversight into coordinated shelter.

activation_trace.role: Preservation, care, and precaution supply the focus-side model of custody.
Interior knowledge makes protective action responsive to actual condition.
Care, preservation, and governance make an encountered people a responsibility rather than scenery.
Departure from sound order supplies the harm that informed protection answers.
Mutual aid turns protective governance into a collective operation.
Strength gathered like rope strands supplies coordinated communal force.
Gathered pieces or blocks give collective force a material protective body.
Equalization between two sides converts assembled material into a completed closure.

structural_cues: The unshielded people before the focus are followed by people requesting a protective barrier.
The builder refuses payment, requests shared strength, and organizes supplied material.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a divine care branch and the ruler's later protective engineering; I infer that informed custody frames his delegated action without identifying the two subjects. The live alternative is that preservation is only a dormant focus branch and the wall is unrelated.

changed_reading.before: Preserving oversight remains an abstract secondary sense of encompassing.
changed_reading.after: It becomes a model of informed custody under which available people, force, and matter can be coordinated into protection.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The shared-portion sense of kh-b-r is distant from the noun's ordinary epistemic sense here, but it remains anchored at focus word 6 and converges with gathering at word 3 plus later cooperative block assembly; render it only as a material-social analogy, not as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 3 can gather dispersed elements, while focus word 6 has a branch for a jointly divided share.

activation_trace.role: Gathering dispersed members supplies the assembly operation.
A divided share in common property supplies distributed holdings as what is known.
Mutual aid activates distributed capacities as a joint contribution.
Strength gathered like strands supplies the integration of separate contributions.
Collected pieces or blocks materialize the assembly of distributed shares.
Equalization supplies the operation that fits separate contributions into one barrier.

changed_reading.before: What was with him is a single undifferentiated inventory.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the clause knows each distributed share or capacity and the possibility of gathering them into coordinated work.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The waterskin and soft-ground branches are homonymous and highly form-distant, yet the model remains anchored in both focus roots and is reactivated by the western spring and later pouring of molten metal; render it as a contained material image for knowledge, never as the clause's direct lexical sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 3 supplies a containing perimeter, while focus word 6 can image either watered low ground or a capacious vessel.

activation_trace.role: Physical enclosure supplies the containing boundary of the image.
The capacious waterskin supplies abundant contents held within a container.
The great bucket or waterskin image gives the western station a vessel-like material echo.
A flowing spring supplies liquid content at the journey's first boundary.
Pouring by emptying a vessel reactivates containment as a deliberate transfer.
Molten copper supplies the dense poured content that seals the later enclosure.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge is represented only as an abstract proposition.
changed_reading.after: As a contained image, divine khubr is capacious enough to hold the overflowing material reality of every station and transformation.

strongest_changes: Repeated finding and later failed comprehension recast the focus as a contrast between episodic encounter and all-sided interior knowledge.
Granted means, intended action, and recompense broaden what was 'with him' from possessions to capacities and accountable use.
The later barrier turns encompassing into nested enclosure: divine knowledge contains the builder, the wall, its limits, and its expiry.
summary.what_was_special: The focus clause works as a hinge: it closes the exposed eastern station, calibrates the traveler's limited viewpoint, and prefigures a physical enclosure whose temporary strength remains inside complete epistemic enclosure.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the later physical enclosure is intentional lexical prefiguration or a retrospective analogy.
Whether preserving custody should color ahata here or remain secondary to complete epistemic enclosure.
The distributed-share and capacious-vessel readings are branch-valid analogies but unlikely contextual lexical senses.
